name: tl;dv
summary: AI notetaker that records Zoom, Google Meet and Teams calls and sends insights to other apps.
description: tl;dv records and transcribes calls on Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams, writes summaries and sends meeting insights to tools such as CRMs and Slack. Teams can search across meetings and automate workflows. The Free plan includes unlimited recordings with no card; Pro costs $18 per seat per month billed annually, and Business costs $29 per seat per month. The company reports more than two million users and GDPR compliance.

howToUse.title: Open tl;dv
howToUse.description: Open tl;dv and get the notetaker on the Free plan, which includes unlimited recordings with no card.

howToUse.title: Record a call
howToUse.description: On a Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams call, tl;dv records the audio and transcribes what was said.

howToUse.title: Read the summaries
howToUse.description: After the call, read the summaries tl;dv writes, then search across past meetings for a specific point.

howToUse.title: Send the insights
howToUse.description: Send meeting insights to a CRM or to Slack, and automate the follow-up workflows.
